summary: Sacks argues that shareholders rightly reapproved Elon's pay package because he delivered on his promises, and the stock ripping on the news confirms that securing Elon's continued leadership is vital to Tesla's future innovation and value.
quote: I think he's absolutely vital to all the innovation that's going to come in the future from Tesla. And you see this, the stock is ripping on the news, is up about 3% today in a down market.

summary: Friedberg argues the original pay package was legitimate, Elon should never have had the options voided, and that shareholders voting 73% in favor both times demonstrates the market correctly values Elon's presence at Tesla.
quote: He should get this stock. He never should have— or these options— he never should have had them taken away. And so I just hope this thing— yeah, it becomes a nothing burger.

summary: Jason argues Apple Intelligence — particularly AI-powered Siri with deep app integration — will win the AI consumer market and drive a new phone upgrade cycle, justifying the 10% stock pop.
